author: Jess Harrison
title: Artist needed for dog memorial painting
content: Hey! I’m looking for an artist who can take a pic and create a painting for a dog memorial. I’m located in Atlanta, but I’m open to working with anybody anywhere.

author: Kat
title: Paid human illustrator for short story series
content: Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work. NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art. I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story. What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives “Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark”. Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration. If you’re an artist who likes to read, even better. I have most of one short done now, have 12 total planned. Artist would get credit as the artist/illustrator for publishing. DM.

author: Collins
title: Urgent original artwork for personal project
content: URGENTLY LOOKING FOR ARTIST Need some original artwork done for a personal project. Looking for a creative person who can follow references but still add their own touch. Good communication is important. Budget: £70–£115 Beginners with decent samples can apply too.

author: Temmycreative
title: Paid vector illustrator for Halloween hoodie design
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid) Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: * One skeleton as the main character * Punk/rock retro horror vibe * Clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS) * Large back print (13” × 16”) * Neon green, purple & orange palette * Original artwork only (no tracing existing designs) Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! For the map, I’d love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel. Portraits for the time being.
